sloka: दृष्ट्वा ताम् अशुचिम् शक्रः पादयोः कृत मूर्धजाम् ।शिरः स्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च ॥१-४६-१७॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tām aśucim śakraḥ pādayoḥ kṛta mūrdhajām ।śiraḥ sthāne kṛtau pādau jahāsa ca mumoda ca ॥1-46-17॥

translations.english: Indra laughed. He rejoiced at the sight of her ominous posture of sleeping with her feet towards her head and her hair falling on her feet.
